correctness.rationale: PASS: The local singular chart is the d-Veronese cone R_d=C[x,y]^(μ_d)=⊕ Sym^{dj}C², with rational normal curve Hankel quadratic presentation on z_0..z_d. For the Fitt₂ ideal every (d−1)-minor of the linear-relation Jacobian has degree >=d−1, so it lies in m^{d−1}. The d−1 genuine quadratic relations f_i=z0*z_{i+2}−z1*z_{i+1} have lower triangular Jacobian in z2..zd with determinant z0^{d−1}. GL2 action preserves the intrinsic ideal; polarization of (ax+by)^{d(d−1)} spans the entire degree-(d−1) Veronese component in char 0. Thus equality and, by direct-product Ω and Fitting-sum identities, gluing along smooth base gives I_Σ^{d−1}. Independently reconstructed symbolic Jacobian minors and Hilbert-length sums for d=3..8 using SymPy; finite checks supplement, not replace, the characteristic-zero general proof. Positive-dimensional base and non-torsion L are retained from claim; no positive-characteristic assertion.
